about: Fact cards for the OnLabel benchmark. Each card names verbatim label text (quotes, checked against the label by evals/build_bench.py) and claims written from it. A claim's op says how it was built; its expected verdict follows from the op (see EXPECT in build_bench.py), never from a model. Written 2026-10-05 against the label versions pinned in data/labels/manifest.json.
